title: THUNDER, STATIC AND THE TURNING SKY
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sound generally, find the actions that have no distinct noise yet and add them. A bolt of lightning landed with the machine alarm, the same sound every machine, the seal cut and a strongbox use, and there was no thunder anywhere in the game. The strike warning and a weather turn played the machine wind-up riser, so the sky sounded like a machine charging. A bolt now lands as thunder: a hard high crack, then a low roll of about a second and a half over a sub thump, the crack fading with distance so a far bolt is all roll, and it still marks its ring when you cannot see it. The warning before a strike is static building over its second and a half, so it leads into the crack. A weather turn plays the sky it turns to: a storm is a distant roll of thunder, rain, fog or a clear sky a gust of wind, a blackout a power-down and a relay clunk. Each window makes its own, so a teammate hears each once. Sound only: nothing in the game changes.
now: Lightning now cracks and rolls like thunder, the strike warning crackles with static, and a weather turn sounds like the sky it turns to.
